All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers. I checked T4, T12 and T13 by hand against the data, and the rest only against the output shape.

- **T10 and T13:** their output prints in qlang's own map and vector syntax, because those queries run with `--raw`.
- **T11:** I didn't check the log file for odd `ms=` tokens, so a malformed one would be missed.
- **Leading pipe:** the queries start with `| ` so Git Bash doesn't turn a leading `/` into a path.

T1: | /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: | /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name
T3: | /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | * count
T4: | /data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce null | if (eq null) ~(null) ~(/login))}

T10: | lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) | * count
T11: | lines | * (split " ") | * (filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: | lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | * (split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/4 | ne "") (/5 | lower | eq "shipped")) | * (:q (/3 | parseJson) | /4 | parseJson | mul q) | sum | round 2
T13: | lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | * (split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/4 | ne "") (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled")) | * {:c /1 :t (:q (/3 | parseJson) | /4 | parseJson | mul q)} | groupBy ~(/c) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | print | drop 1) :total (/1 | * /t | sum | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
